title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Tagment PCR Amplicons
author: Opentrons
materials: Pick up 200 uL tips from slot 4
Dispense into trash and discard tips.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module and wait 3 minutes for the beads to pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate 60 µL from column
steps.instruction: Aspirate 60 µL from Column 1 (well A1) of the magnetic plate located in Slot 3.

steps.title: Dispense 100 µL wash buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of Wash Buffer into Column 1 (well A1) of the magnetic plate in Slot 3.

steps.title: Pause: seal, shake, centrifuge
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, seal the plate, shake and centrifuge as instructed, then place the plate back on the magnetic module and resume the run.

steps.title: Re‑engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module again and wait 3 minutes for beads to pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate 100 µL supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL of supernatant from Column 1 (well A1) of the magnetic plate in Slot 3.

steps.title: Perform second wash cycle
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash steps (engage magnetic module, wait 3 min, aspirate 60 µL, dispense 100 µL wash buffer, pause for seal/shake/centrifuge).

substeps.instruction: Engage magnetic module and wait 3 minutes for beads to pellet.
Aspirate 60 µL from Column 1 (well A1) of the magnetic plate in Slot 3.
Dispense 100 µL of Wash Buffer into Column 1 (well A1) of the magnetic plate in Slot 3.
Pause the protocol: seal, shake, centrifuge, then replace plate on magnetic module and resume.
